text:
matt_supp: Escalating a customer onboarding issue — AcmeCo activation webhook failing intermittently since yesterday, 2x trial seats blocked, their trial ends in 5 days. raising as renewal-risk if not resolved. ticket: https://tickets.internal/ACME-4781 :warning:
alyssa_csm: acked, thanks Matt. can you paste the top error logs and confirm whether this is a config vs infra issue?
matt_supp: here's the latest error from the prod-worker logs:
```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z ERROR webhook-handler: 502 Bad Gateway from auth-service POST /v1/activate  (timeout after 10s)
2026-03-20T18:12:05Z WARN retrying activation for user 9876 (attempt 3)
```
matt_supp: we see a spike of 502s across multiple orgs but AcmeCo only started hitting it after they tried SSO link. ticketbot: ticket ACME-4781 created and linked to infra-pipe.
jordan_se: quick note — looks like the auth-service had a rolling restart yesterday in us-west-2; there was a misapplied envoy config that increased circuit timeouts. infra applied a rollback but some pods stayed unhealthy for ~40m. i can run a focused test with their tenant id to confirm.
elaine_cs: thanks — two asks: 1) we need a short comms plan for AcmeCo (customer-facing, low-friction) to avoid churn; 2) CS needs an enablement session scheduled ASAP once activation completes so they can finish onboarding. i'll draft the comm and assign owners.
alyssa_csm: propose this comms sequence: 1) short acknowledgement email now + we are investigating (sent by support), 2) 24h update if not resolved (CS-owned), 3) post-resolution: invite to a 30m enablement + propose renewal check-in. sample message: "Hi <Name>, thanks for flagging — we're investigating an activation issue affecting a small subset of customers. Our engineers are on it and we expect an update within 24 hours. We apologize for the disruption and will keep you posted."
matt_supp: sending acknowledgement to Acme contact now. copy for review: "Hi Maya — quick note that we’re aware of activation errors and are investigating with engineering. We’ll update within 24 hours. Apologies for the interruption to your trial experience." :email:
elaine_cs: looks good. i'll prepare the calendar invite for the enablement + renewal touch. who will drive the technical follow-up? Jordan?
jordan_se: I can take the triage owner. I'll run tenant-level repro and ping infra if I see pod restarts. Estimated ETA to determine root cause: 4 hours.
alyssa_csm: tagging renewal risk — marking ACME as "at-risk" internally and moving renewal touch earlier. @elaine_cs please add to renewal dashboard.
elaine_cs: done. updated renewal dashboard with severity=medium, risk_reason="activation failure pre-demo", next_contact=2026-03-22.
matt_supp: update: infra confirmed envoy rollback completed; auth-service error rate dropped to baseline ~5m ago. I retried the webhook and activation succeeded for test user.
jordan_se: can confirm — repro attempts now return 200. I'll escalate a postmortem ask to infra for a short RCA and mitigation timeline (re: circuit timeouts).
elaine_cs: great — next steps: 1) CS to send post-resolution note and propose enablement times; 2) Support to close the high-urgency ticket with summary; 3) Eng to produce a 1-paragraph RCA for customer-facing follow-up. Who will draft the customer-facing RCA?
jordan_se: I will draft the 1-paragraph RCA and share in this thread within 6 hours.
alyssa_csm: please include a mitigation ETA and a clear statement that their data and keys were not impacted. keep tone concise and empathetic.
matt_supp: I'll close the ticket after we have the RCA and the enablement invite. sending closure draft now.
elaine_cs: thanks team. i'll also schedule the enablement for Wed/Thu windows; will share options in DM with Acme. please react with :thumbsup: when you have action items done.
aya_bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 24h for ACME-4781.
matt_supp: :thumbsup:
alyssa_csm: :thumbsup:
jordan_se: :thumbsup: 
elaine_cs: :thumbsup:
